cases.title: 64 entries, включая хвост после 20
cases.expected: Page union equals expected ordinal set; 56/6/2 state counts; EOF only after last entry

cases.title: Бинарный source с printable fragments
cases.expected: All fragments remain raw-only/ineligible; no current repository text hits

cases.title: UTF8 with NUL/C0 controls
cases.expected: Strict decode alone does not enable text; BINARY_CONTROL_HEURISTIC reason

cases.title: Empty/BOM/CRLF/long UTF8 lines
cases.expected: Exact bytes, empty [0,0), hashes and text eligibility; no normalization

cases.title: Invalid Python syntax
cases.expected: Text fallback ELIGIBLE, parser failure shown without AST/source execution claim

cases.title: Canonical LFS pointer
cases.expected: Pointer SHA/size recorded as declared; external availability NOT_CHECKED; no payload capture claim

cases.title: Malformed/extended/legacy LFS
cases.expected: Distinct malformed/unsupported reasons; raw kept; no guessed payload status

cases.title: README с примером pointer
cases.expected: Ordinary UTF8 content does not become LFS pointer due to embedded URL

cases.title: Link/submodule/unsupported path
cases.expected: Every metadata row retained; reversible path token; no target traversal

cases.title: Protected/excluded и wallet false positive
cases.expected: Three policy reasons remain distinct; wallet_logic.py eligible; protected bytes not in output

cases.title: Oversize/missing Git blob
cases.expected: ERROR rows/gaps retained with original reason/known budget; no fabricated hash or fetch

cases.title: Legacy store + replay/crash backfill
cases.expected: UNKNOWN before backfill; atomic per-source commit; replay reuses same binding; raw revisions unchanged

cases.title: Incremental UTF8 across chunk boundary
cases.expected: Split multi-byte codepoint validates whole source; truncated codepoint fails; independent expected bytes

cases.title: Damaged raw/ranges/revision/hash
cases.expected: CORRUPT_CAPTURE; no ELIGIBLE/ready projection; unaffected valid entries preserved

cases.title: Read-only Native scope
cases.expected: Unknown field/cross-namespace/alias/profile/cursor mismatch rejected; query does not invoke Git/backfill/proof

cases.title: Byte budget и changed filter
cases.expected: Whole envelope <=32,768; exact continuation; one oversized row explicit error; old numeric offset cap absent

cases.title: UI stale replies + malicious labels
cases.expected: Snapshot/filter navigation rejects stale reply; textContent; ineligible text choices disabled; paging responsive

cases.title: Manifest/ZIP compatibility
cases.expected: Old raw hashes/revision/formats valid; binary raw retained; format extension version bound; unknown proofs stay NOT_RUN
